changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ResourcePasswordReset') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[ResourcePasswordReset]( [ID] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_ResourcePasswordReset_ID] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, [ResourceID] [int] NOT NULL, [CreateDate] [datetime] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ResourcePasswordReset] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
